content_zh:
随着数学老师邓永川的一声念出，全班轰然大笑。
几乎所有的人都转过去看着坐在教室最后排的那个黑色短发的少年，而他就是莫凡，一个考出奇葩个位数分数的家伙。
“莫凡，你要好好向穆白学习，别人这么难的试卷都考了96分，你怎么就考出个别人零头来呢，别辜负了你的名字。”邓永川叹了口气道。
怎么自己班级出了这么一个问题学生，明明入学是第一名的成绩，到了高中就一下子堕落了，考出来的成绩惨不忍睹，疯狂的扯班级平均分的后退。
“老师，他已经很对得起他得名字了，莫凡，莫凡，就是不平凡嘛，他比平凡还低了几级，快成渣了。”那个叫做穆白的学生说道。
“哈哈哈哈哈~~~~”
“说的真是！”
“不愧是穆白，骂人都可以不带脏字，确实不平凡，都已经成渣了！”
班级里一片笑声，直到邓永川开始讲课大家才停下来。
“这个穆白好恶心，以为长得帅、成绩好、会音乐就很了不起啊！”坐在莫凡旁边的一个黑炭脸关谷说到。
“一个幼稚的****而已。”莫凡完全不屑道。
“放学打双排去啊？”
“有事，不去了。”
“又去帮那个嬴老头啊？后山那破茅屋也就你敢去，对了，我弄了几本玄幻、魔幻小说来看，先借你一本？”
“放我书包里，不过你这家伙少看点这些小说，都走火入魔了。”莫凡说道。
对学生来说最美妙的铃声自然是下课铃，结束了一整天枯燥的课程后，莫凡打着哈欠背着书包往后山走。
后山是学院后门，基本上没有人去的。
同桌关谷说的嬴老头就是学院后山的守卫，学校为了保障学生安全同时也不让寄宿生从后山溜出去网吧通宵，所以让赢老头守在那里。
老人无亲无故，前段时间过世了都无人问津，校方帮他草草入土。
莫凡和赢老头挺熟的，老头走前说是留了一些东西给莫凡，莫凡到了今天才想起来老人家的一片好意，于是去他的茅屋看看。

赢老头总说他自己是某个历史上很牛逼人物的传承人，手头上拥有一件五千年古董戒指……
莫凡见过那个戒指，黑不溜秋的，根本就不像什么古董，最重要的是莫凡其实早就拿这个戒指去鉴定过了，老板不耐烦的把他轰了出去说这烧煤炉调出来的铜戒指也好意思当古董来卖，所以莫凡就再也没有相信赢老头吹嘘的那些了。
老人家临走前的好意，莫凡就当是一个纪念收下了。
赢老头是一个豁达的老门卫，对生死看得其实很淡薄，莫凡也祝愿他好走，死亡没准是这个服务器混不下去，到新服开号重练呢？
“你信不信，在这个崇尚科学的位面平行之处，还有一个魔法位面，在那里学习的不是科学是魔法……”
这是赢老头经常会对莫凡说的一句发神经的话，所以莫凡看到他离去后也深信他去别的服务器开小号了，风生水起。
戒指很容易就找到了，竹床下面的木盒子里面。
莫凡挺玄乎的，不过莫凡都十五六岁的人了，可不会相信这个世界上真有功法，更不会相信赢老头戴上他的戒指学习它的功法就可以拯救宇宙的那套说辞。
黑不溜秋戒就是很普通的指环，非要说特别的话，就是内部有八个很小的巢孔，普通工匠都做得到的。
黑不溜秋戒冰冰凉凉的，莫凡戴上去的时候马上就感觉到一阵透心凉，大夏天的竟然一阵哆嗦，有点古怪！
“古怪个屁啊。”思考片刻，莫凡就否定了那脑残的想法。
晚上还要去干活，正好一阵困意袭来，莫凡整理了一下竹席就在屋子里躺下了，先睡一觉，10点那会还得去二十四小时超市当营业员，得熬到凌晨6点。
困意很浓，莫凡直接就睡过去了。
残阳从山缝间泄落下一道血红色的光丈，染红了后山这片树林，也染红了这间小小的茅屋。
就好像是一片黑暗之中的巨门正在缓缓的关闭，泄落在黑暗中的光辉一点点的收入到门内，当夕阳完全沉入到山下一切被昏暗统治的时候，这一片后山宛如被蒙上了一层奇异的色彩。
远远看去，这一片区域好像是虚无的，水中的朦朦胧胧的景象，血阳下的海市蜃楼！

content_en:
As the math teacher Deng Yongchuan read out, the whole class burst into laughter.
Almost everyone turned to look at the young man with short black hair sitting in the back row of the classroom. He was Mo Fan, a guy who got a weird single-digit score in the exam.
"Mo Fan, you have to learn from Mu Bai. Others scored 96 points on such a difficult test paper. How can you get a fraction of others? Don't live up to your name." Deng Yongchuan sighed.
Why is there such a problem in my class? A student who was ranked number one when he entered school suddenly fell into disgrace when he got to high school. His grades were appalling and he was driving the class average back crazily.
"Teacher, he is already worthy of his name. Mo Fan, Mo Fan is just extraordinary. He is several levels below ordinary and is about to become a scumbag." The student named Mu Bai said.
"Hahahahaha~~~~"
"That's true!"
"As expected of Mu Bai, he can even curse people without using curse words. He is indeed extraordinary. He has already become a scumbag!"
There was laughter in the class, and everyone did not stop until Deng Yongchuan started teaching.
"This Mu Bai is so disgusting. He thinks that being handsome, having good grades, and being able to play music means he is great!" Guan Gu, a charcoal-faced man sitting next to Mo Fan, said.
"Just a childish bastard." Mo Fan said with complete disdain.
"Are you going to play double queue after school?"
"I have something to do, so I won't go."
"Are you going to help that old man Ying again? You are the only one who dares to go to that shabby hut in the back mountain. By the way, I have got some fantasy and magic novels to read. Can I lend you one first?"
"Put it in my school bag, but you guys should stop reading these novels, you've become obsessed with it," Mo Fan said.
The most beautiful bell for students is naturally the end of get out of class bell. After a long day of boring classes, Mo Fan yawned and walked back up the mountain with his schoolbag on his back.
The back mountain is the back entrance of the college, and basically no one goes there.
The old man Ying mentioned by his deskmate Guan Gu is the guard in the back hill of the college. In order to ensure the safety of students and prevent boarding students from sneaking out to the Internet cafe all night long, the school asked old man Ying to guard there.
The old man had no relatives and no one cared about him when he passed away some time ago. The school helped him to be buried hastily.
Mo Fan and Old Man Ying were quite familiar with each other. Before he left, the old man said he had left something for Mo Fan. Only today did Mo Fan remember the old man's kindness, so he went to his hut to have a look.
Old man Ying always says that he is the heir to a very powerful figure in history, and he has a five-thousand-year-old antique ring on hand...
Mo Fan had seen that ring before. It was so black that it didn’t look like an antique at all. The most important thing was that Mo Fan had actually taken the ring to have it appraised. The boss kicked him out impatiently and said that the copper ring made from the coal-burning furnace was willing to be sold as an antique, so Mo Fan no longer believed what old man Ying was bragging about.
Mo Fan accepted the old man's kindness before he left as a souvenir.
Old man Ying is an open-minded old guard who actually has a very indifferent view of life and death. Mo Fan also wishes him a good life. Maybe his death is because he can't survive in this server. How about retraining when the new server is opened?
"Believe it or not, parallel to this plane that advocates science, there is also a magic plane, where what is learned is not science but magic..."
This is a crazy thing that old man Ying often says to Mo Fan, so after seeing him leave, Mo Fan was convinced that he had gone to another server to open a small account, and he was prosperous.
The ring was easily found, in a wooden box under the bamboo bed.
Mo Fan is quite mysterious, but Mo Fan is fifteen or sixteen years old, and he doesn't believe that there are real skills in this world, let alone old man Ying's rhetoric that he can save the universe by wearing his ring and learning its skills.
The Hei Bu Liu Qiu Ring is a very ordinary ring. If I have to say something special, there are eight very small nest holes inside, which can be made by ordinary craftsmen.
Hei Bu Liu Qiu Jie Bingbing is cool, Mo Fan immediately felt a chill in his heart when he put it on. He was actually shivering in the summer, which was a bit weird!
"That's weird." After thinking for a moment, Mo Fan rejected the crazy idea.
He had to go to work in the evening, and a feeling of sleepiness hit him. Mo Fan arranged the bamboo mat and lay down in the room. He wanted to sleep first. At 10 o'clock, he had to work as a salesperson in a 24-hour supermarket and had to stay up until 6 o'clock in the morning.
Feeling very sleepy, Mo Fan fell asleep immediately.
The setting sun shed a blood-red light from the cracks in the mountains, dyeing the woods on the back mountain red, and also dyed this small thatched hut red.
It was as if a huge door in the darkness was slowly closing, and the light leaking out in the darkness was entering the door bit by bit. When the sunset completely sank into the mountain and everything under the mountain was dominated by darkness, the back mountain seemed to be cast in a strange color.
From a distance, this area seems to be nothingness, a hazy scene in the water, a mirage under the bloody sun!
